{
  "version": 2,
  "description": "Markdown正本の意味を保持し、path/surfaceの直接一致とdepends_on closureを必須ruleとして機械適用する。topics/domains/activitiesは探索用、priorityは適用除外に使わない。",
  "resolution_order": [
    "specific_applies_to",
    "depends_on",
    "overrides",
    "priority",
    "stop_and_clarify"
  ],
  "review_routing": {
    "governed_paths": [
      "apps/web/**",
      "apps/api/**",
      "tools/aidd/**",
      "docs/ai-driven-development/**",
      "docs/harness/**",
      "docs/adr/0001-adopt-harness-engineering.md",

      "docs/adr/0004-separate-task-scope-from-work-kind.md",
      ".agents/**",
      ".codex/**",
      ".github/skills/code-review/**",
      ".github/agents/**",
      ".github/workflows/aidd_*",
      "AGENTS.md",
      "CLAUDE.md"
    ],
    "surfaces": [
      {
        "id": "web-project",
        "paths": ["apps/web/**"],
        "required_rules": ["policy.code-review", "infrastructure.overview", "web.test-policy"]
      },
      {
        "id": "web-source",
        "paths": ["apps/web/src/**"],
        "required_rules": [
          "web.component-structure",
          "web.design-system-brand",
          "web.design-rules",
          "web.feature-directory",
          "web.query-cache",
          "web.suspense-boundaries"
        ]

      {
        "id": "web-storybook",

          "apps/web/src/**/*.stories.tsx",
          "apps/web/.storybook/**",
          "apps/web/.storybook-test/**"
        ],
        "required_rules": ["web.component-structure", "web.storybook-browser-tests"]
      },
      {
        "id": "api-project",
        "paths": ["apps/api/**"],
        "required_rules": [
          "policy.code-review",
          "infrastructure.overview",
          "policy.transaction-boundaries",
          "policy.temporal-data",
          "domain.amount",
          "domain.date",
          "domain.payment",
          "domain.category",

          "domain.user"

          "CLAUDE.md"

    ]
